summary: DestProfileHistory is a user control component used in the HSPnet web application for displaying and interacting with destination profile history data. It uses an object data source to fetch data based on session and destination identifiers, and provides grid display and button/label controls.
purpose: The purpose of DestProfileHistory is to allow users to view and interact with historical data for a specified destination profile, filtered by session and agency context, within the HSPnet system.

fields.name: gridData
fields.purpose: Displays destination profile history in grid format

fields.name: UserSession
fields.purpose: Session object containing AgencyID and other session data

workflows.name: Display Destination Profile History
steps: User control is loaded with UserSession and DestID properties.
If UserSession is null, data selection is cancelled.
If UserSession is present, input parameters are set: DestinationCodeID = DestID, SessionAgencyID = UserSession.AgencyID, sess = UserSession.
gridData displays the returned history data.

business_rules: Data selection for destination profile history requires a valid UserSession.
validations: UserSession must not be null for data retrieval.
conditions: Cancel data retrieval when UserSession is null.
Proceed with data retrieval when UserSession is valid.
system_behavior: Cancels or allows ObjectDataSource selection based on session validation.
Sets parameters for data fetching according to session and destination context.
exceptions: UserSession is null: data selection is cancelled and no data is retrieved.
content_gaps: Details of business actions related to buttons/labels are not specified.
Specific workflows beyond data retrieval and display are unclear.
No information about error handling or edge-case behavior beyond UserSession validation.
